channel.description: Latest articles from Holy City Sinner (holycitysinner.com)

item.title: Gov. McMaster Names 2026 South Carolina Chef Ambassadors
item.description: Gov. Henry McMaster on Thursday named chefs from Myrtle Beach, Greer, and Charleston to represent South Carolina as 2026 Chef Ambassadors.

item.title: American College of the Building Arts and Redux Contemporary Art Center Announce Continued Partnership
item.description: Following the success of previous workshop sessions, the American College of the Building Arts (ACBA) and Redux Contemporary Art Center (Redux) are excited to announce the third round of classes and workshops as part of the Redux Education program

item.title: South Carolina ETV and Public Radio to provide comprehensive coverage of winter storm
item.description: Gov. Henry McMaster has declared a State of Emergency as a winter storm system is expected to impact South Carolina beginning Saturday.

item.title: Commonhouse Aleworks Celebrate 8th Anniversary with Vendor Market and Block Party on Feb. 7
item.description: Commonhouse Aleworks will celebrate its eighth anniversary with a Vendor Market and Block Party on Saturday, Feb. 7, from noon to 10 p.m. The event is free to attend and open to all ages.

item.title: New Charleston Festival Combines Top Chefs, Bluegrass & Community for a Cause
item.description: Local nonprofit AMOR Healing Kitchen is hosting a birthday bash unlike any other: AMOR Fest, a community celebration and fundraiser bringing together Charleston chefs, musicians, artists and families at Freehouse Brewery on Saturday, Feb. 21.

item.title: U.S. 17 and Main Road quarterly project update set for Feb. 4
item.description: Charleston County Public Works officials will host a quarterly public meeting for the ongoing U.S. 17 and Main Road project (Main Road Segment A) at 6:30 p.m., Wednesday, February 4 at St. John’s High School, located at 1518 Main Road.

item.title: Thirteen South Carolina Schools Selected as Finalists for Palmetto’s Finest Awards
item.description: Thirteen schools from around the state have been selected as finalists for the 2026 Palmetto’s Finest Awards. This selection comes after extensive evaluations by a committee of fellow educators and previous Palmetto’s Finest winners.

item.title: Charleston Battery add Ivorian midfielder Laurent Kissiedou on multi-year deal
item.description: The Charleston Battery are excited to announce the signing of midfielder Laurent Kissiedou to a multi-year contract on Saturday, pending league and federation approval. The Ivorian returns to the club where he recorded his professional debut in 2017.

item.title: 18th Annual Captain’s Comic Expo Scheduled for Feb. 21 & 22
item.description: Captain's Comic Expo (CCE), the two-day festival celebrating comic book culture, returns to Patriots Point in Mt. Pleasant on Feb. 21 and 22, 2026. The 18th annual event will be held within the Omar Shrine Temple at 176 Patriots Point Rd.

item.title: Local Organizations Announce Protest After Second Civilian Fatally Shot by ICE in Minneapolis
item.description: On Sunday, Jan. 25 at 5 p.m., community members and local organizations in the Lowcountry will gather for a protest in response to the fatal shooting of a civilian (Alex Pretti) Saturday morning by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents
